observation.visible_scene: A close-up view inside a stainless steel wok holding a stir-fry mixture of shredded orange carrots, pale white sprouts/cabbage, and brown meat strips. A thin metal utensil shaft with a white grip rests at the left edge of the pan, partly buried in the food. A plume of steam rises above the contents throughout the clip.
visible_changes: The steam plume continuously swirls, thins, and shifts position above the food from frame to frame, the main visible motion in the scene.
The food pieces (carrot strands, meat strips, sprouts) stay in essentially the same arrangement across the segment; no stirring or tossing is visible.
The camera framing drifts slightly (a small zoom-out/pan), progressively revealing more of the white utensil grip at the left edge that is mostly cut off in the early frames.
The utensil itself does not move relative to the food; its growing visibility is due to the framing change, not object motion.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the wok is heated and whether any stirring/tossing occurs before or after this segment.
Whether a person is holding the utensil (no hand is visible).
The final cooking result of the dish.
uncertain_details: The exact type of camera motion (pan vs. slight zoom) is hard to confirm because the background is the curved pan wall.
The precise identity of the white strands (bean sprouts vs. shredded cabbage/onion) is not certain.
